messages:
Priya: Heads-up — prepping QBR for Meridian (renewal in ~6w). Need an exec-ready 2-slide ask + 1-pager risk summary. Can team confirm slide owners? :wave:
Sam: I can own the 2-slide ask (rev impact + recommended play). Will draft today and pull numbers from the console.
Jordan: I’ll take the onboarding health slide. Current onboarding completion 78% (3 delayed integrations). Will add mitigation actions.
Casey: FYI renewal risk score jumped 0.24 -> 0.42 after last week's NPS. Main themes: prompt tuning support and SKU/pricing clarity.
Priya: @Casey can you paste the raw NPS comments (anonymized) we can quote on the exec slide?
Casey: Sure — snippets below (anonymized):

```
"We hit weird hallucination spikes after swapping to the quantized model — no clear tuning docs."
"Billing buckets are confusing — our finance team needs a clear SKU map."
```

Summary: 2 top issues: model tuning docs + billing clarity.
Danielle: I’ll assemble the 1-pager risk summary + action tracker. Need the SLA incident list for the quarter — @Sam can you attach a short log?
Sam: Dropping the SLA snippet from Console: `Q1 incidents: 3 infra, 1 latency; avg MTTR 2.3h; outages 0` — will upload full CSV to drive and share link.
EBR-bot: Reminder: QBR dry run scheduled Fri 10:00am PT — invite sent to the execs + AMs.
Priya: Thanks. Quick asks: keep slides max 4 so execs see the ask quickly; include fallback if customer requests Dedicated capacity (cost/latency tradeoff).
Jordan: On onboarding health remedies — quick wins: concierge sessions, prebuilt integrator templates, and a scripted kickoff. Will include TTF (time-to-first-call) and avg integration latency metrics.
Casey: For renewal playbook propose: 1) tech remediation + concierge, 2) commercial concession ladder if NPS doesn't improve by 2 pts, 3) exec sync window. I’ll draft language for the one-pager.
Sam: Uploaded draft rev-impact table to Drive here: https://drive.redwood/rev/meridian-qbr (will set perms). Numbers: FYR impact ~$120k ARR at risk, downside $45k.
Priya: Owner recap: Slides – Ask (Sam), Onboarding (Jordan), Risk one-pager (Danielle), Feedback capture + quotes (Casey). Action items assigned — can everyone confirm by EOD? :thumbsup:
Jordan: Confirmed. I’ll post a slide draft by 4pm.
Casey: Confirmed. I’ll include the anonymized quote and short NPS verbatim.
Danielle: Confirmed. I’ll template the action tracker and add owners + due dates.
Priya: Great — small note: bring two mitigations per risk to the dry run. We’ll run through sequencing and who speaks to execs. See you Fri. :calendar:
